owner_direction: Gui: preserve modules separately, enable on demand, allocate employees to reusable teams and scoped access profiles, including temporary allocation
purpose: Practical organization/unit/team administration without per-employee module configuration or customer forks

entities.access_profile: Organization-owned, versioned explicit action permissions and supported resource scopes; separate from team membership and personal appearance
entities.team: Organization-owned work group, optionally limited to one validated unit, referencing approved profile revisions
entities.team_assignment: References an existing active organization membership; base or temporary; start/end instants, reason, version and actor
entities.delegation: Which units, profiles and actions a director may administer; does not grant unrestricted customer or platform access

workspace_projection.organization: Approved business modules/extensions shared by the customer's subscribed and operational scope
workspace_projection.unit: A verified resource scope and local operational context, never a customer fork
workspace_projection.team: Work allocation; categories such as department, shift or project are descriptive
workspace_projection.profile: Job function and allowed actions; distinguish attendance operator, reviewer and administrator even inside HR
workspace_projection.employee: Navigation, search and task views derive from currently effective authorized assignments; personal preferences never broaden authority
workspace_projection.combination: Combine approved action/resource-scope pairs from active assignments. Never union actions and scopes independently, which could spread one team's Finance permission to another unit. Domain restrictions and separation-of-duties rules still apply.

organization_setup: Select a validated business module bundle and compatible suggested extensions for the customer
Instantiate curated job-function profiles as organization-owned revisions; review before publishing
Create units and categorized teams referencing those approved profiles
Invite or allocate existing employees in a batch with a changed-access preview; invitations alone grant nothing
Use the same approved profile across teams rather than duplicate per-person settings
Removing one team assignment affects that allocation only; suspending organization membership ends all organization access while retaining historical attribution

module_extension_defaults.meaning: Declared compatibility and suggested extensions for an installed module
module_extension_defaults.authority: No default list activates an extension, grants permissions or bypasses required dependencies
module_extension_defaults.selection: Organization administrators choose eligible, validated modules/extensions; unit directors remain within delegated options

effective_access: currently effective team/profile assignment and explicit action permission
resource belongs to the current organization and permitted unit/classification scope
domain transition and segregation-of-duties conditions hold
administration_rules: Organization owner controls profile publication and organization-level module activation
Unit director manages only delegated units, teams and approved profile revisions
A director cannot publish a more privileged profile, widen own scope or self-grant administration
Teams may share profiles; employees may have several explicit assignments
Categorization alone never grants authority; no arbitrary inherited group nesting in the first slice
Moving the base allocation atomically ends the previous base assignment and starts the new one; temporary overlays remain explicit
Temporary assignments require an expiry checked by server time on every protected operation; a cleanup job is not the enforcement mechanism
Preview changed access and affected employees before publishing profile changes or batch allocations
Protect the last organization administrator; elevated administration changes require an authorized second actor when policy requires it
Use current audited command/idempotency/version contracts for allocation, removal, movement and publication
Reauthorize pending work, downloads, exports and replay after team/profile changes; cached navigation or JWT labels are not current authority
Individual exceptions are uncommon, reasoned, time-bounded and visible in the audit
resource_scope_limit: A unit-scoped profile is offered for a module only after that module can enforce unit/resource scope in its actual API/database/file paths. An organization-only domain must not pretend to enforce units through a menu or frontend parameter.
compatibility: Evolve the existing authoritative membership/permission resolver. Do not add an independent role engine, import ClubAL authentication or copy materialized grants per employee without an explicit migration/invalidations contract.
source_reuse: Preserved Base44 PlatformAdminPage role/profile presentation and ConfigurationCenterPanels forms are candidates; legacy groups there group clients, not employee teams. Semantic adaptation remains necessary.
delivery: Current contribution: inert source bank, administrative catalog and this proposal; no schema/grant change
First consuming slice: minimal identity/profile/team contracts plus a real M5 administrative consumer; preserve current M4 priority
Then verified unit delegation, temporary/batch moves and role-specific workspace projection
Extend to M6/M8 specialties only with validated module-specific scopes and permissions
acceptance_cases: One profile assigned to two teams updates the affected access coherently with explicit revision publication
HR-only employee cannot invoke Finance/Fleet operations by direct URL or API
Unit A director cannot administer Unit B or another organization
Multiple assignments combine only approved permissions within their own scopes
Temporary access expires while a tab and queued operation are still open
Moving an employee removes prior base access atomically; duplicate/lost-response retry adds no second assignment
Revoked membership/session denies access even with a retained group label
Missing module, disabled extension, ineligible organization or unsatisfied dependency still denies access
Read, edit, review, approve and export remain distinct; requester cannot approve own critical operation
Existing M1-M4 isolation, commands, audit, history and recovery continue passing after migration
